topic: x86-64 condition codes and control flow
scope: Illustrative x86-64 AT&T syntax; compiler output is not claimed exact.
assumptions: cmp source,destination sets flags based on destination minus source
4-bit interactive comparison is a toy model, not a hardware operand width

claims.claim: CMP sets status flags from subtraction without retaining result
Signed JL and JGE use SF/OF while unsigned JB and JAE use CF
Switch lowering and loop shape depend on compilation and optimization
Machine-level programming belongs to textbook chapter 3, not site chapter 5

interaction: 4-bit signed/unsigned comparison, deterministic; no benchmark claims
